title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Ptarmike flowers shift from bruise-poultice component to sneeze trigger
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. In the complete critical Greek Dioscorides II.162, leaves together with flowers are applied as a poultice to remove bruises below the eyes, while the flowers themselves provoke sneezing very effectively. Preserve the repeated flower participant while its role changes from coingredient in a topical remedy to the active cause of a different bodily response.
